subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw approve a separate Channel Broker SDK/plugin conformance harness, or should broker-like lifecycle coverage continue through the existing `channel-inbound` and `channel-outbound` contracts?
rationale: Current main has adjacent generic channel lifecycle contracts but no broker SDK/plugin, and the prior implementation stack was closed unmerged, so adding the harness requires product/API boundary intent before implementation.

options.title: Keep Existing Channel Contracts
options.body: Use `channel-inbound` and `channel-outbound` as the canonical lifecycle boundary and rewrite broker-specific work into narrower gaps against those contracts.

options.title: Approve A Broker Seam
options.body: Sponsor a smaller design for a provider-facing broker SDK/plugin and then add a conformance harness around that approved seam.

options.title: Pause The Program
options.body: Keep the issue open as a design parking lot until channel churn or external provider demand justifies reopening the broker direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Existing Channel Contracts
recommendation.body: Use `channel-inbound` and `channel-outbound` as the canonical lifecycle boundary and rewrite broker-specific work into narrower gaps against those contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent supplied the clearest maintainer boundary decision on the linked PR stack and is tied to adjacent channel SDK history in current blame.
